newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures untraded in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures untraded in quiet trade.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded by midday on Tuesday with most players marking time by sitting on the sidelines waiting for fresh factors to perk up trade, dealers said.
"It's totally dead. The low volumes in Japan is also not helping the market any. No one wants to do anything," a local rubber trader said.
Dealers predicted that the light buying seen for RSS3 rubber may be seen again later in the day.
"What can you say in a market where nothing happened this morning," one dealer said.
At around 0445 GMT, March RSS3 was indicated at 122.00-124.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 123.25 cents.
March RSS1 was indicated at 173.00-175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.23-$1.25) a kg from the previous 175.25 cents.
March TSR20 was indicated at 168.00-170.00 Singapore cents (US$1.20-$1.21) a kg from the previous 169.50 cents.
